purpose: Freeze the benchmark-first, pre-core reproduction gate before any RIFT implementation is added under src/StaticAnalysis.

status_vocabulary.PASS: The bounded claim and its oracle were executed and verified.
status_vocabulary.PARTIAL: A useful bounded subset or data import passed, but the complete published method was not executed.
status_vocabulary.BLOCKED: The intended execution could not be completed because an upstream artifact or required environment component was unavailable.
status_vocabulary.NOT_RUN: The activity is outside this gate or is deliberately deferred; it supplies no positive evidence.

gate_policy.published_artifact_rule: At least one original published artifact component must execute on a public artifact case. An unavailable second artifact remains BLOCKED and is never converted to PASS.
gate_policy.decision: All seven required steps are PASS. The original-artifact rule is satisfied only by the original LTL-Fuzzer Automata component plus the public Problem1 execution. FGS remains BLOCKED, while PGFuzz and MoonShine remain PARTIAL.
gate_policy.does_not_mean: This gate does not establish that RIFT exists, that any RIFT accuracy or performance target is met, or that a fuzz campaign changed an AP.

steps.subject: LTL-Fuzzer ICSE 2022 original Automata component
steps.claim_boundary: The unmodified artifact Automata library was built and executed on the artifact's public Problem1 property and consumed the saved iH,oZ,iB,oZ event sequence. This is not the LLVM-instrumented end-to-end fuzz campaign.

steps.subject: LTL-Fuzzer public RERS Problem1 program
steps.claim_boundary: The public Problem1 C program was compiled with Clang 18 and run once on its shipped 1000-byte input. This confirms deterministic artifact-case execution, not target-directed fuzz effectiveness.

steps.subject: LTL-Fuzzer complete LLVM-instrumented fuzz campaign
steps.claim_boundary: The artifact pins LLVM 11 and its instrumentation does not build with the available LLVM 14 APIs. The failure is preserved; no campaign, reachability, or time-to-target result is claimed.

steps.subject: LTL-Fuzzer public AP target tuples
steps.claim_boundary: Forty-nine tuples were imported: 46 RERS tuples resolve exactly and three Telnet tuples remain unresolved because the source gitlink is unavailable. Imported tuples are comparison inputs, not causal influence gold.

steps.subject: PGFuzz NDSS 2021 policy/input maps
steps.claim_boundary: The 56 paper policies were reconciled with 51 public policy maps; five Paparazzi maps are absent. The result is explicitly SILVER_STANDARD_NOT_GROUND_TRUTH and no PGFuzz campaign is claimed.

steps.subject: MoonShine read/write implicit dependency
steps.claim_boundary: The official precomputed dependency map contains mlockall to msync, and a faithful Clang micro-reproduction validates W(mlockall) intersection R_cond(msync). The unpublished Smatch extraction hooks and original extractor were not executed.

steps.subject: FGS FSE 2024 original artifact
steps.claim_boundary: Zenodo exposes only a README that points to rmrepo/fgs:latest; that image is unavailable. No FGS executable, smoke, NIST case, graph-reduction, time, memory, or precision result was reproduced, and no substitute implementation was created.

steps.subject: libcoap deterministic Clang/LLVM 18 compilation baseline
steps.claim_boundary: At frozen commit 94bacc8939dd6711169cd2332a002a361ec62531, three isolated compilation runs produced identical compilation databases, static archives, and linked bitcode; LLVM MemorySSA completed. DTLS, examples, and tests were disabled, so this is compilation evidence only.

steps.subject: ArduPilot Copter Clang 18 build baseline
steps.claim_boundary: The frozen ArduPilot commit built Copter with Clang 18 in an isolated directory, emitted a 1336-entry compilation database, and passed the ArduCopter help smoke without modifying source. AP binding, SITL GCS-failsafe execution, and fuzzing are NOT_RUN.

steps.subject: SVF 3.2 official WPA/SVFG smoke
steps.claim_boundary: The clean official SVF-3.2 tag built 124/124 targets on LLVM 18 without source patches. Official wpa passed one MAYALIAS and one NOALIAS oracle and constructed MemorySSA plus a 78-node/75-edge SVFG. No upstream Test-Suite, large-project accuracy, AP binding, controllability, async semantics, or RIFT result is claimed; the ad-hoc API runtime diagnostic is excluded from acceptance.

steps.subject: Frozen RIFT portability contract
steps.claim_boundary: The pre-core contract validates project-neutral core interfaces and forces all libcoap, MQTT, MAVLink, and ArduPilot knowledge into versioned external model packs. This is a design gate, not evidence that three-project runtime portability has already passed.

steps.subject: Pre-core implementation boundary
steps.claim_boundary: src/StaticAnalysis contained zero entries when this aggregate gate was captured. This validator is intentionally a historical pre-core gate and must fail after implementation begins.

steps.subject: RIFT-M2 mechanically checkable influence benchmark
steps.claim_boundary: M2 starts only after this aggregate validator passes. No M2 accuracy or RIFT implementation result is part of M1.

integrity_anchors.role: SVF build and WPA smoke facts

supported: The pre-core M1 gate has an original published component execution, deterministic libcoap LLVM input, a frozen ArduPilot Clang 18 build, and an executable SVF value-flow substrate.
Unavailable and incomplete artifacts remain visibly BLOCKED, PARTIAL, or NOT_RUN.
The project-neutral core/model-pack boundary was frozen before implementation.
not_supported: No RIFT analyzer, AP influence cone, fuzzable frontier, mutation recipe, or residual ranking has been implemented or evaluated.
No static accuracy, runtime, memory, fuzz utility, AP flip, or comparative superiority claim is supported by M1.
No FGS runtime result, complete LTL-Fuzzer campaign, original MoonShine extractor run, PGFuzz campaign, ArduPilot SITL scenario, or libcoap protocol test is claimed.

next_milestone.entry_condition: validate_m1.py reports TOTAL PASS while src/StaticAnalysis is still empty.
next_milestone.first_work: Freeze the common result schema and mechanically generated gold cases before implementing weak baselines or the RIFT core.
